selection_rule: exactly one entry whose cli, profile and route match and whose inclusive [min_version, max_version] contains the CLI version selects the source description, contract and mapper; overlapping entries are a configuration error rejected at load; no match retains the acquired input under the untested-compatibility contract and flags it, never the numerically nearest entry; a version inside the range that is not listed under tested is reported in_range (reviewed range, not individually tested); a version not yet known is reported version_unknown until the stream reports it

routes.stdout: the CLI's raw standard output read by the capture process (no SDK stage)
routes.sdk: stream lines delivered by a vendor SDK (claude-code-sdk rawJson); a filtered surface
routes.native_session_file: the file the CLI wrote on its own account, read after the run
